fonts.display: 'ITCGaramondStdLightNarrow', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'PPNeueMontreal', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Page canvas — warm off-white that makes the black ink read like printed type rather than screen pixels

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Primary text, body copy, headlines, section rules — the single ink that carries the whole page

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Muted helper text, timestamps, secondary metadata — desaturated enough to recede behind Carbon

palette.name: Lampblack
palette.role: Hard borders on outlined controls, maximum-emphasis rules — used sparingly where Carbon is not black enough
